update.title: Citation corrections (#2136): section pointers and follow-on books
update.method: 1. Reference parser (lib/narrativeregister.py _BODY): a chained part followed by '.digit' is a narrative section pointer ('; 10.1'), not a chapter; 49 false whole-chapter citations in 19 chapters are dropped. 2. Bare follow-ons that took the book of the previous reference while the prose named another book: the book is now named in the reference. Found by the unresolved list, a scan for a book named in the prose between a reference and its follow-on, and a check of each follow-on's quote against its resolved verse. Chapters whose text is unchanged are re-read at their current version (from_version = to_version).
update.claims_changed_note: No claim text changed. Only reference wording in five chapters.
update.notes: Text changes: Ch 2 v19 (1 Corinthians 15:45, 15:54, 15:55); Ch 9 v3 (Ephesians 4:23, Ecclesiastes 3:21); 10.10 v24 (Nehemiah 6:8, was read as Acts 6:8); Ch 11 v32 (Proverbs 15:28); 13.1 v24 (Matthew 12:14, Acts 4:28, Matthew 23:38-39, was read as Luke 23:38-39). Not changed: Psa 116:9 (Ch 2) and 1Sa 17:19 (Ch 4) have no verse row (governance.verse_gap_by_design); the references are correct.
